KIOS Editor
Edit the world. Ship the diff.
Point this at your Crusader Kings III/game folder — or any mod — and it builds the real map out of the real files. Paint culture, faith, development, holdings, terrain and who rules what, then export a mod containing only what you changed.

Religions
A faith lives inside a religion, and the religion decides its family, its god-names and the doctrines every faith in it inherits. Moving a faith rewrites both religions on export — the one it left and the one it joined — because leaving the old one alone would let vanilla go on declaring it.

Everything else
Click a faith to move it. A faith takes its family and inherited doctrines from whichever religion it sits in, so moving one can change what it is as much as what it is called.
Heritages
Make a heritage and choose which cultures belong to it. Heritage is a culture pillar, so a new one exports as a full pillar definition; membership is written on each culture as heritage =.
New key
Copied from the heritage selected above, then renamed. Its modifiers and effects come across with it and can be edited in the Pillars window.

Who holds them
De jure nesting alone will not colour them in Realm & Holders. That mode reads who holds each county and deliberately refuses to borrow a holder from a superior title, so unheld land stays black however it is nested.
